instruction: Guide me through installing the McMojave cursors theme from gnome-look.org and switching to it on my GNOME desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to install McMojave cursor theme from gnome-look.org and apply it using GNOME settings. Evaluator checks if cursor-theme setting contains 'McMojave' by executing gsettings command and checking the output. Uses existing framework functions (check_list metric + cache_file getter). Similar complexity to original task - both involve downloading theme from gnome-look.org and applying via GNOME settings, but targets cursor theme instead of GTK theme.
metadata.verification: Verified that gsettings 'org.gnome.desktop.interface cursor-theme' is a valid GNOME setting. McMojave is a well-known cursor theme available on gnome-look.org. Task is feasible and similar to original, just targeting a different theme type.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to install and apply McMojave cursor theme
Postconfig appropriately executes 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface cursor-theme' to retrieve current cursor theme setting
Data flow is correct: postconfig saves output to cache file → get_cache_file retrieves file path → check_list searches for 'McMojave' pattern
Complete coverage: instruction asks to install and change to McMojave theme, evaluator verifies cursor-theme setting contains 'McMojave'
Runtime feasibility confirmed: gsettings is standard GNOME utility, get_cache_file and check_list are existing framework functions that will work correctly
Expected value 'McMojave' is semantically correct for this verification task
